vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Label vulnerability-driven pull requests security and leave them for a human to merge, since they skip the release-age bake

lockFileMaintenance.description: Open the lock file refresh past the concurrent limit and merge it on green CI, so transitive dependency fixes keep reaching develop

packageRules.description: Exempt update types that carry no release timestamp from the minimum release-age bake, so their renovate/stability-days check can resolve under internalChecksFilter:strict
The release_versions endpoint Renovate reads carries no release timestamps, so a release-age bake here would never resolve its renovate/stability-days check under internalChecksFilter:strict
Move each dependency in one pull request across all of its pins, so develop never holds two versions of it
Move engines and @types/node to a new Node.js major only once it reaches LTS
Merge development dependency patch and minor updates on green CI
Merge production dependency patch updates on green CI

customManagers.description: Track annotated *_VERSION pins in shell scripts, including the ${VAR:-default} override form
Track annotated feature versions in devcontainer.json that the devcontainer manager doesn't map to a datasource
